git: results/**/trajectory.h5 and STEP_RECORDS.json are ignored by .gitignore (kept locally, not in Git); the other files are untracked until reviewed; nothing committed.

recovery: rsync -a -e 'ssh -p <port> -i <key>' root@<host>:/workspace/scratch/<folder> results/ while the server exists; otherwise only the local copy remains (check it against this manifest).
